BorraLoco removes tracking from links you share: X/Twitter, Spotify, Instagram, Threads, Snapchat, TikTok, YouTube, Temu, SHEIN, AliExpress, Trendyol, Amazon, Facebook, Reddit, LinkedIn, Pinterest and more, plus `utm_*`, `fbclid`, `gclid` and other common trackers on every website.

**Install:** download the `.apk` file below and open it on your Android phone (Android 8.0 or newer). Allow "Install unknown apps" when asked.

**Use it:**
- In any app, tap **Share → Clean link**
- Select a link and pick **Clean link** from the menu
- Add the **Quick Settings tile**: copy a link, tap the tile, the clean link replaces it on the clipboard
- Optional: turn on **Clean every link I open** in the app's settings and set BorraLoco as your default browser

**New in 1.10:**
- **Clean text.** Paste any text into the app and buttons appear only for what is in it. Hidden marks: C2PA provenance data, invisible and zero-width characters, hidden Unicode-tag messages, VSRMark watermarks, unusual spaces, and (separately) chatbot citation markers. Emoji, flags and Arabic/Persian joiners are kept. Word-choice watermarks such as SynthID cannot be removed this way. Works offline.
- **Google Ads links.** `google.com/aclk` ad links: the advertiser's page is read from the link (or followed when the link carries none) and cleaned, and `gad_source`, `gad_campaignid`, `srsltid` and similar are removed.
- The app no longer shows every button at once: link buttons appear when the text has links, text buttons when it has hidden marks.

**In 1.9: Copy caption.** Paste an Instagram post/reel or TikTok video link into the app and tap **Copy caption**: the public caption is read from the platform and copied. Public posts only; only the clean post address is sent to Instagram/TikTok (no tracking, no login). The Share menu is unchanged.
